Little Green Valley (California) | Little Green Valley is a valley in the San Bernardino Mountains, of San Bernardino County, California.  Its mouth lies southwest of Crafts Peak at an elevation of 6,972 miles / 2,125 meters.  Its head is at at an elevation of 7500 feet.  Deep Creek has its source at the head of this valley.
